title: Residual-Based Causal Discovery via Pretrained In-Context Quantile Regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.29530v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Residual-based causal discovery assumes that each variable is generated from its parents and an independent noise source. It estimates this noise and tests its independence from candidate causes. For identifiable functions such as additive-noise models (ANMs) and the broader class of location-scale noise models (LSNMs), this principle identifies the causal direction, as only the causal model admits this independence. Existing LSNM methods rely on parametric assumptions to obtain standardized residuals, risking model misspecification. In contrast, the RESIT-framework allows for nonparametric estimation of residuals to iteratively identify sink nodes, but was proposed for ANMs. To close this gap, we propose Loscar, an extension of RESIT to LSNMs that estimates the conditional mean and scale via quantile regression, enabling pretrained tabular foundation models as plug-in estimators. We compare it with a feasible generalized least squares

translated_title: 基于预训练上下文分位数回归的残差因果发现
translated_abstract: 基于残差的因果发现假设每个变量由其父节点和一个独立的噪声源共同生成。该方法通过估计这一噪声并检验其与候选原因之间的独立性来推断因果关系。对于可识别的函数类别，如加性噪声模型（ANM）及更广泛的位置-尺度噪声模型（LSNM），该原理能够识别因果方向，因为只有正确的因果模型才满足这种独立性。现有的LSNM方法依赖参数化假设来获得标准化残差，存在模型误设的风险。相比之下，RESIT框架允许对残差进行非参数估计，从而迭代地识别汇节点，但该框架最初是为ANM提出的。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了Loscar，这是RESIT在LSNM上的扩展方法，通过分位数回归估计条件均值和条件尺度，使预训练的表格基础模型能够作为即插即用的估计器。我们将其与可行的广义最小二乘法进行对比……
tldr: 该论文提出Loscar方法，将RESIT框架从加性噪声模型扩展至更广泛的位置-尺度噪声模型，通过分位数回归非参数化地估计条件均值和尺度，并支持将预训练的表格基础模型作为即插即用估计器，从而避免了现有方法对参数化假设的依赖。
